descriptions.notStarted: A mysterious figure starts talking to you…
descriptions.inProgress: When you accept the invitation from the mysterious figure, you find yourself in front of a strange-looking cave! Inside the cave...is the kid with the puppets! So that's the kid responsible for manipulating the monsters in #m100000000# and #m101000000#? Talk to the kid and see what's up.
